tools.name: skuvault_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the regular warehouses (Id and Code). The numeric Id is what the stock tools and skuvault_list_transactions need. SkuVault throttles this call to 1 per minute. POST /inventory/getWarehouses.

tools.name: skuvault_list_locations
tools.description: List the locations in enabled warehouses with warehouse, location code, parent location/container and total quantity. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /inventory/getLocations.

tools.name: skuvault_list_products
tools.description: List products (not kits) with description, cost, prices, brand, supplier, classification, reorder point and quantities (on hand, available, pending, picked, incoming...). Filter by SKU or code, or by modification time. Alternate SKUs come back as separate rows (IsAlternateSKU) unless you filter. Hea

tools.name: skuvault_get_product
tools.description: One product (not a kit) by SKU or by code: details plus all quantities (on hand, available, pending, picked, incoming, in stock). Give exactly one of sku or code. Light throttling (20/min). POST /products/getProduct.

tools.name: skuvault_list_kits
tools.description: List kits with their component lines, optional available quantity and cost. Needs a modified-time window (defaults to all time). The page size is not documented: keep following `next` until a page comes back empty. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /products/getKits.

tools.name: skuvault_list_brands
tools.description: List the brands created in SkuVault (Name, IsEnabled), 1,000 per page. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /products/getBrands.

tools.name: skuvault_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers in the account (Name, IsEnabled), 10,000 per page. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /products/getSuppliers.

tools.name: skuvault_list_classifications
tools.description: List product classifications and their named attributes, 1,000 per page. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /products/getClassifications.

tools.name: skuvault_get_inventory_by_location
tools.description: Where each product is stored: per SKU (or code) the locations with warehouse code, quantity and whether the location is a reserve location. Filter by SKUs or by codes (not both). Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /inventory/getInventoryByLocation.

tools.name: skuvault_get_available_quantities
tools.description: Sellable (available) quantity per SKU across all warehouses, with last-modified time. Use modified_after to see only what changed. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /inventory/getAvailableQuantities.

tools.name: skuvault_get_item_quantities
tools.description: Product quantities per SKU: total on hand, available, held, pending and picked. Filter by product codes or modification time. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /inventory/getItemQuantities.

tools.name: skuvault_get_warehouse_quantities
tools.description: SKUs and quantities held in one warehouse. Get the warehouse id from skuvault_list_warehouses. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /inventory/getWarehouseItemQuantities.

tools.name: skuvault_list_transactions
tools.description: Inventory transaction history (adds, removes, picks, creates) with user, SKU, quantity before/after, location, reason, note and the sale it belongs to. The date range may span at most 7 days. Filter by user email, warehouse id, type, reasons or sale id. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /inventory/getT

tools.name: skuvault_list_sales
tools.description: List sales (orders) that are ReadyToShip (default) or Pending, or look up specific sales by order id (then status is ignored): items, kits, shipping and contact info, totals. Not paged by the vendor. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /sales/getSales.

tools.name: skuvault_list_sales_by_date
tools.description: Sales within a date range, by sale date or by last-modified date: items, kits, fulfillment/processed quantities, shipping, contact info and totals. The date range may span at most 7 days. The most common way to pull orders. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /sales/getSalesByDate.

tools.name: skuvault_list_sold_items
tools.description: Items sold in a date range: date, SKU, quantity and total price per line, optionally breaking kits into components and including transfer sales. The date range may span at most 14 days. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /sales/getSoldItems.

tools.name: skuvault_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders with supplier, dates, status, payment status, costs and line items (SKU, quantity, received quantity). By default completed POs are left out: set status Completed to see them. Specific PO numbers override the date and status filters. 10,000 per page. Heavy throttling (5/min). PO

tools.name: skuvault_list_po_receives
tools.description: Purchase-order receiving history: what was received (SKU, quantity, location, user, dates) followed by quantity corrections. Filter by warehouse codes, PO numbers or received time. Heavy throttling (5/min). POST /purchaseorders/getReceivesHistory.

tools.name: skuvault_list_integrations
tools.description: List the enabled sales-channel accounts (Amazon, ChannelAdvisor, Shopify...): Id, LongId, Name and Type. Severe throttling (1/min). POST /integration/getIntegrations.

tools.name: skuvault_add_stock
tools.description: WRITE: add quantity of a product to a warehouse location (a transaction in SkuVault's history; every call adds again, so do not retry blindly). The transaction reason must already exist in SkuVault. Serialized or lotted products need serial numbers / a scanned lot code. Moderate throttling (10/min).

tools.name: skuvault_remove_stock
tools.description: WRITE: remove quantity of a product from a warehouse location (a transaction in SkuVault's history; every call removes again, so do not retry blindly). The transaction reason must already exist in SkuVault. Serialized products need serial numbers. Moderate throttling (10/min). POST /inventory/remove

tools.name: skuvault_set_stock_quantity
tools.description: WRITE: set the exact quantity of a product at one warehouse location, overwriting what is there (running it again with the same values changes nothing more). Use skuvault_get_inventory_by_location first to see the current quantity. Moderate throttling (10/min). POST /inventory/setItemQuantity.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: skuvault_list_warehouses, skuvault_list_locations, skuvault_list_products, skuvault_get_product, skuvault_list_kits, skuvault_list_brands, skuvault_list_suppliers, skuvault_list_classifications, skuvault_get_inventory_by_location, skuvault_get_available_quantities, skuvault_get_item_quantities, skuvault_get_warehouse_quantities, skuvault_list_transactions, skuvault_list_sales, skuvault_list_sales_by_date, skuvault_list_sold_items, skuvault_list_purchase_orders, skuvault_list_po_receives, skuvault_list_integrations · Private data: skuvault_list_sales, skuvault_list_sales_by_date · Public sink: skuvault_list_warehouses, skuvault_list_locations, skuvault_list_products, skuvault_get_product, skuvault_list_kits, skuvault_list_brands, skuvault_list_suppliers, skuvault_list_classifications, skuvault_get_inventory_by_location, skuvault_get_available_quantities, skuvault_get_item_quantities, skuvault_get_warehouse_quantities, skuvault_list_transactions, skuvault_list_sales, skuvault_list_sales_by_date, skuvault_list_sold_items, skuvault_list_purchase_orders, skuvault_list_po_receives, skuvault_list_integrations, skuvault_add_stock, skuvault_remove_stock, skuvault_set_stock_quantity · Destructive: skuvault_remove_stock.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
